spec: UPS starter-pool Boom/Bust/Startable, agent B reference (B_model.py core())

conventions.scores_and_thresholds_in_tenths: t = Math.round(score*10); quantiles computed on sorted int tenths; compare ints/exact halves, never float points
conventions.quantile: linear R-7: h=(n-1)p; lo=floor(h); hi=min(lo+1,n-1); q=s[lo]+(s[hi]-s[lo])*(h-lo)  (== d3.quantile on sorted array)
conventions.rate: Math.round(100*n/q) when q >= 3 else null  (half rounds UP: 5/8 -> 63, Python round() would give 62)

row_schema.rostered: bool (on a UPS roster in that week's weeklyResults)
row_schema.snaps_total: int off+def+st, null = no snap row
row_schema.mfl_score: float, null = no MFL score row
row_schema.nfl_team: team code for that week, null = no NFL team

end_to_end.description: Synthetic WR group. Wk1 pool n=6 with a played-zero starter (in pool) and a no-show starter (out). Wk2 n=9: thresholds land on observed scores -> exact ties at P25/P50/P75. Wk3 n=5 < min_pool -> no thresholds. Wk4 n=8 with P25 == P50 (degenerate tie). Team CCC has no game in Wk2 (not a bye); team BBB bye in Wk3.
